tested_scope: One deterministic self-local replay of the exact prior continuation. Initial state: immutable predecessor claim C10 for key K5/g8/owner_A/F10, current_claim_fence=F11, claim_head=digest(C10), finalization_slot=ABSENT. Construct two distinct successor attempts C11A and C11B, both at fence F11 and both naming predecessor=digest(C10). Each may install only through one atomic compare-and-set requiring current_claim_fence==F11 AND claim_head==digest(C10) AND finalization_slot==ABSENT. Evaluate both serializable CAS orderings, preserve C10 and both attempted successor records as provenance, and authorize an effect only when candidate.fence==current_claim_fence AND digest(candidate)==claim_head AND finalization_slot==ABSENT. No real concurrent GitHub writers, public-source checks, external side effects, hosted coordination, richer-mode arbitration, O/downstream/other-worker state, scheduler state, or second semantic leaf were used.

weak_rules_falsified: W36: two F11 successors targeting the same C10 predecessor may both successfully install if each observed C10 before attempting mutation.

observations: In either modeled CAS ordering, the first successor changes claim_head away from digest(C10), so the second successor's identical predecessor-head precondition fails.
The losing attempt remains provenance but is not effect-authorized because its digest is not the active claim_head.

A same-generation retry against predecessor digest(C10) remains non-authorized after a winner installs; safe retry would require a newly validated generation/predecessor relation rather than reusing the stale precondition.
inference: Within this deterministic model, an atomic CAS over {current fence, exact predecessor head, absent finalization} plus head-bound effect authorization is sufficient to serialize two competing same-fence successor attempts to one authorized winner while preserving all attempted records. This does not prove that a concrete Chat-exposed repository primitive can atomically enforce the full predicate, nor does it solve crash ordering between an external effect and finalization.
